references.meaning: Three viewing bays along the northern side of the Skyway.
An open viewing space reaching the inclined outer glazing, with guard rails and information boards.

limits: The existence and open interior of the viewing bays are evidenced; exact opening dimensions, support sections, fabrication and load paths are not surveyed.
Sloped perimeter frames and ties are an explicit construction hypothesis. Geometric connectivity is not a structural engineering validation.
The existing central corridor and bay registration remain provisional; future photographic alignment may change these openings.
Exterior glazing and every outer-grid member must remain exactly unchanged. Only intersecting inner chords, diagonals and depth struts may be modified.
Front headers are set beneath the registered glass with a 20mm geometric gap; this is not a measured construction tolerance.
Bottom frame tops meet the provisional 160mm deck underside; the actual suspended floor construction remains to be registered.
Front header placement includes a conservative half-diagonal tube envelope in plan and height, rather than measuring clearance only at the member centerline.
